description: Use this to turn a video into a depth map video (Video Depth Anything, on BudgetPixel's own GPUs): a steady, flicker-free video where near is white and far is black, at the input's size (up to 1080p) and frame rate (up to 30 fps). Use it as a depth / structure / motion reference or control video for video models — grayscale (the default colormap) is what they take as a depth reference; turbo, inferno, magma and viridis colour it for viewing only. Priced per second of the INPUT video, rounded up to whole seconds, 5-second minimum, by model size: small 20 / base 30 / large 40 credits per second (a 5-second clip or shorter costs 100 / 150 / 200, a 10-second clip 200 / 300 / 400). The resolution does not change the price. small is fastest; base adds edge detail; large draws the finest detail (hair, thin poles, distant people) and is the steadiest. Input: a video URL (pass one from upload_media for local files), up to 30 seconds and 50MB. Options: size (default small), colormap (default grayscale), resolution (default auto = the input's size, never upscaled), keep_audio (copy the input's audio), side_by_side (input on the left, depth map on the right). The price is held when the job starts and charged on success only; a failed job is never charged. Jobs take about 1-2 minutes: the tool returns a job_id — poll check_generation_status with that job_id and type "depth" every 15-30 seconds until it returns the finished depth video, then tell the user. The depth video is also saved to the user's BudgetPixel library.

colormap.description: grayscale (default; near = white, far = black) is what video models take as a depth reference. turbo, inferno, magma and viridis colour the depth map for viewing — not for use as a reference.

keep_audio.description: Copy the input's audio into the depth video (default false).

resolution.description: The output's short side: auto (default) keeps the input's size, up to 1080p. It never upscales, and the price is the same at every resolution.

side_by_side.description: Put the input on the left and the depth map on the right, twice the width (default false).

size.description: Model size, which sets the price per second of input video: small 20 (default, fastest), base 30 (adds edge detail), large 40 (finest detail — hair, thin poles, distant people — and the steadiest).

video.description: The video to turn into a depth map: an http(s) URL (a generated video's URL, or one from upload_media for local files). Up to 30 seconds, ≤50MB. Required.
